description: spec-0.7.0: A computed receipt whose tx (2024-03-16T08:00) is later than its latest input's tx (2024-03-15T16:00) and not after its asof: valid. A withdrawal the verifier cannot see may have raised tx (8.2), so 7.5 bounds tx below by the latest input's, it does not equate them.

code.body: amount * rates.example.org/fx_rate(base: base, date: date, quote: quote)
